entities.name: Christoph Weigel the Elder
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johann Christoph Weigel, known as Christoph Weigel the Elder, was a German engraver, art dealer and publisher. He was born at Redwitz, Free imperial city of Eger in Egerland, and died in Nuremberg, aged 70.
